sources.title: GitHub Copilot | Microsoft Learn
sources.snippet: Microsoft Agent Framework supports creating agents that use the GitHub Copilot SDK as their backend. GitHub Copilot agents provide access to powerful coding-oriented AI capabilities, including shell command execution, file operations, URL fetching, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration.

sources.title: Supported AI models in GitHub Copilot
sources.snippet: For all of the default AI models, input prompts and output completions run through GitHub Copilot's content filters for harmful, offensive, or off-topic content, and for public code matching when enabled.
